auth.title: Authentication
auth.intro: Every request is authenticated with a workspace API key. Create one in the dashboard under Settings, REST API. Send it as a Bearer token:
auth.alt: Alternatively pass it in an X-Api-Key header. Keys belong to a single workspace and only their hash is stored, so copy a key when it is created: it cannot be shown again. Keys can be revoked at any time and stop working immediately.

webhooks.title: Webhooks and real-time events
webhooks.comingBody: Registering a webhook and receiving events at your own URL is not available yet. No events are sent to your server today, so there is nothing to subscribe to. This card will list the events and the signature header when delivery goes live.
webhooks.rate: Each key is held to the per-minute limit of the workspace plan; when the plan sets none, the platform default of {limit} requests per minute applies. Every answer carries X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining, and a request over the limit is answered with HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header. Outbound sends also draw from your plan's message credits.
